description:
Read one of your saved task types (#583), including its prompt_template, gate and review_policy, which handinloop_list_task_types does not show.

Args:
  - id: the saved task type's id.

Returns { id, name, description, output_fields, prompt_template?, gate?, review_policy? }. A built-in type, or an id you have not saved, is not found.
name: handinloop_get_task_type
title: Read a Saved Task Type
